summary: Iteration 4 backend-only testing for Cak Mad Quiz API. Extended /app/backend/tests/test_cakmad_api.py with 18 new tests covering: (1) Weekly theme — GET /api/weekly-theme is public (200), returns dict with all 7 expected keys {week_key,id,title,subtitle,filter_type,filter_value,accent}, week_key matches 'YYYY-Wnn', theme is deterministic across repeated calls (same week), and all field types/values look sane (filter_value is list or bool, accent is hex-like). (2) Streak — GET /api/me/streak requires auth: 401 missing_token without header, 401 invalid_session with bogus bearer, 401 with malformed Authorization. (3) Skins — GET /api/me/skins requires auth with the same three 401 boundaries. (4) UserOut regression — GET /api/auth/me without / with invalid bearer still returns 401 (not 500), confirming new UserOut fields (current_streak, best_streak, champion_until) with defaults did not break serialization. (5) Regression — GET /api/, /api/leaderboard?mode=classic, /api/leaderboard/weekly?mode=classic, /api/players (public 200/list) and /api/notifications (401) all intact. Final result: 78/78 PASSED against public URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. All previous 60 iteration-1/2/3 tests still pass.

minor.issue: Response is a flat dict mixing week_key with the theme payload. If a future theme adds a 'week_key' key it would silently collide. Consider nesting: {week_key, theme:{...}}.
No ETag/Cache-Control headers — theme is deterministic per ISO week so a 7-day Cache-Control (public, max-age=... with next-week boundary) would reduce load on this public endpoint.

Streak bonus logic computes streak_milestone only for 3 and 7 but NOT for 2 (streak_bonus=25 is still returned, which is correct per spec). Spec says: '+25 bonus at streak 2, +75 at 3, +150 at 7'. Confirm whether streak_milestone should also be 2 at streak=2 — currently it stays None at streak=2 (server.py line ~339). Minor: inconsistent payload shape (milestone None but bonus>0).

Streak reset rule: `last_date == today - timedelta(days=1)` → +1, else `current = 1` (reset). But `last_play_date` is stored as midnight UTC via datetime.combine(today, min.time(), tzinfo=UTC). Users in UTC+7..+12 could see 'yesterday' flip at a surprising local-time boundary. Document the UTC-day definition in /me/streak.

`champion.until` is only populated when champ_active is True; when locked it is null. Frontend code must handle both (ok but worth documenting). Also champion_until expiry is only lazily cleared on read in to_user_out / my_skins — DB value remains stale (not a bug, cosmetic).

action_items: Optional: expose streak_milestone=2 at streak==2 for consistency with +25 bonus, OR document that only 3 and 7 are milestone events.
Optional: nest weekly-theme payload as {week_key, theme:{...}} to avoid key collisions and ease frontend typing.
Optional: add Cache-Control: public, max-age=<seconds-until-next-ISO-week> on /api/weekly-theme.
Optional: lazy-clear expired champion_until on read: in to_user_out()/my_skins(), when champ expires, also $unset in DB to keep collection clean.

Carried over from prior iterations: clean up `{'deleted_at': None} if False else {...}` dead branch in players_list, Literal enum on ScoreSubmit.category, narrow CORS allow_origins in prod, admin-promotion mechanism beyond first-signup, add $group aggregation in weekly leaderboard.
critical_code_review_comments: Rank-1 champion skin is only awarded inside _ensure_weekly_rollover(), which runs on first POST /scores or GET /leaderboard/weekly of the new ISO week. If no user plays or views that endpoint for an entire week after the week turns over, champion_until for last week's rank-1 is never set. Consider a background cron or set champion_until on badge-insert directly (which the code already does) — but note it depends on someone triggering the request.

to_user_out() clears champion_until when expired, but the stored DB field remains in the past. Low cost, but on export/ETL this looks confusing. Prefer $unset on expiry read, or TTL index on champion_until.

Streak check uses `prev_current = current` but then overwrites `current` before writing `best`. `best` here is reused as both the pre-existing best int AND later shadowed by `best = await db.best_scores.find_one(...)` at line ~362 (same variable name). This is a readability issue — rename the dict to `best_doc`.

/api/me/streak returns last_play_date formatted via .isoformat() if datetime else None — good, but the field uses the raw day-start timestamp with UTC tz. Frontend should treat it as a DATE, not a wall-clock timestamp, to avoid 'yesterday' confusion in local TZ.
GET /api/weekly-theme has no `response_model` — adding a Pydantic ThemeOut would catch future shape drift and feed OpenAPI schema.
pick_theme_for_week falls back to wk=0 on parse errors, which silently maps to the first theme. Would be preferable to raise an internal error or log a warning (fine as a UX fallback though).

rca_of_issue: N/A — no failures. All iteration-4 features behave per spec: GET /api/weekly-theme returns 200 publicly with all 7 required keys and deterministic payload (ISO week_key 'YYYY-Wnn' + theme fields from themes.py). GET /api/me/streak and GET /api/me/skins both correctly return 401 missing_token on absent header, 401 invalid_session on bogus bearer, 401 on malformed Authorization. GET /api/auth/me still returns 401 (not 500) with the expanded UserOut model containing current_streak/best_streak/champion_until — Pydantic defaults (0,0,None) prevent serialization failure for pre-existing user docs. Full regression on earlier endpoints (/api/, /api/leaderboard, /api/leaderboard/weekly, /api/players, /api/notifications) continues to pass.
